chapter: Hampton, Blue Note and the electric guitar
title: Being dependable and always getting paid
summary: He says he was known because he never disappointed anyone, always arrived early and expected his money right after the job.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: (Coughing) Boy, I sure hope I never go through this no more.
Do you want some juice? There's some juice over there.
It's right next to the can. To the right of the can.
No, not that far. A little more to the left. There you go. Reach down. There you go.
Yeah, the thing is, Chuck, why I was known so much, you know, was because they could depend on me. I never disappointed nobody.
And that was the biggest part of my feelings, you know. And that was why they knew me. They'd say, 'Well, we can get Teddy Bunn because we can always depend on him,' and it was true.
I never disappointed them. They'd tell me to be there at 3:00 o'clock, I'm there at 1:00 o'clock, before time.
Knowing I had to do something. Why the heck shouldn't I be there? I ain't doing nothing else.
And that's more respect I'd get, from knowing that I would be there. Instead of them saying, 'Well, we hired him and he never did show up,' which I've heard that many a time.
Oh, so have I, you know. So and so didn't --
That cat didn't even show up to make this money.

I don't know why. He must have some chick somewhere. That's what they first put on you, some chick done him in. Which sometimes is right. But whatever happened to me, I'd be there to make my money and forget it. Just give me my check when I'm finished, that's all. Or however you're going to pay me. Just give it to me when I'm finished.

And that's business. I always thought. I've been doing it since I was seven years old. Every time I'd play they'd give me my money. Even the little house functions. Like we hear now there's a big party on here and I'm playing the only music in there.
I'm playing it by myself. Shoot, they better have my money ready. I couldn't fight them, as little as I was, but yet and still I dared nobody, because my mother and dad would sure get ahold of it.
Yeah. They were the collector's item. Yeah. They wouldn't let me down, as far as money was concerned.
I'm going to play another recording here.
